registered_tldr: TLDR: Poietic D0-01 tests the repaired Haiku, Qwen and Jev action interfaces on three paired four-step cases per role: fetch, answer, refresh and structural change. Compare against protected expected actions; require 12/12 valid and correct per role with zero protected access. Maximum 36 calls, no retries; an interface failure stops that role and transport/integrity failure stops all. Diagnostic only: not full qualification, a model ranking, or evidence of swarm benefit. Owner approved this scope; original cumulative USD 2 cap and spending ledger retained. Prior S0-02 failed on its first interface response. Raw traces remain private; publish aggregates and hashes.
